chain.title: A material for the storage room
chain.desc: Craft Quartz Enriched Iron using this pack's recipe. Keep a supply for machine casings, cables, and storage components.

chain.title: Processor raw material
chain.desc: Smelt nether quartz into silicon using the installed recipe. It is one part of every processor, so set aside enough for the controller and your first storage devices.

chain.title: Bind the processors
chain.desc: Craft Processor Binding and gather the metals required for each processor tier. Raw processors must be smelted before they become usable components.

chain.title: Make the basic processors
chain.desc: Craft and smelt Raw Basic Processors. These support storage and network hardware; batch them alongside silicon instead of repeatedly rebuilding the recipe.

chain.title: Frame the network devices
chain.desc: Make Machine Casings for the controller, grid, and storage hardware. They are shared components, so choose the first devices around a small usable network.

chain.title: An improved processor
chain.desc: Craft and smelt the gold-based Improved Processor. Use it for more capable network devices as your storage needs grow.

chain.title: Insert and construct
chain.desc: Create a Construction Core. This component supports devices that place or move stored resources outward from your system.

chain.title: Extract and recover
chain.desc: Create a Destruction Core for the extraction side of the network. It complements construction components in grids and item-routing devices.

chain.title: Advanced control
chain.desc: Craft and smelt the diamond-based Advanced Processor. Reserve the first one for the controller, then expand toward crafting and wireless devices.

chain.title: Power the storage network
chain.desc: Supply the Controller with Forge Energy and connect the first devices. Watch network power use as you add machines; extra grids and drives also consume energy.

chain.title: Reach the workstations
chain.desc: Run cables from the powered controller to nearby devices. Keep the first network compact so power and connection problems are easy to find.

chain.title: A shell for the disk
chain.desc: Build a Storage Housing for your first item disk. The housing is only the container; a storage part supplies the usable capacity.

chain.title: The first storage capacity
chain.desc: Craft a 1k Storage Part and combine it with a housing. Larger parts can come later; a working small network is enough to start organizing the base.

chain.title: Assemble the first disk
chain.desc: Combine the part and housing into a storage disk. Insert it into a Disk Drive before testing the grid.

chain.title: Install your disks
chain.desc: Connect a Disk Drive to the controller and install a storage disk. Leave room for additional drives or use external storage for large bulk inventories.

chain.title: Search, store, retrieve
chain.desc: Connect a Grid and test both depositing and withdrawing items. A blank grid can mean an empty disk, missing storage, or an unpowered network.

chain.title: Bring machine outputs home
chain.desc: Attach an Importer to a chest or machine output. Configure filters and test a small batch before continuously feeding resources into the network.

chain.title: Keep a machine supplied
chain.desc: Use an Exporter to stock selected items in a machine or inventory. Set filters deliberately to avoid filling a machine with the wrong ingredient.

chain.title: Keep bulk storage where it is
chain.desc: Attach External Storage to an existing inventory and set its priority. Bulk drawers or barrels can stay in place while the Grid presents their contents alongside disk storage.

chain.title: Craft without leaving storage
chain.desc: Upgrade to a Crafting Grid for manual recipes using stored items. This convenience does not depend on completing the autocrafting branch.

chain.title: Encode repeatable recipes
chain.desc: Create a Pattern Grid and encode a simple recipe. For machine processing, describe exact inputs and outputs and ensure the finished products return to storage.

chain.title: Request your first automatic craft
chain.desc: Connect a Crafter, insert a pattern, and request a small job. Place processing Crafters against the target machine and return its outputs through an Importer or another valid route.

chain.title: Extend access beyond the room
chain.desc: Attach a Wireless Transmitter to the network. Range upgrades and dimension access depend on the installed version and addons, so check the local upgrade recipes.

chain.title: Storage in your hand
chain.desc: Charge a Wireless Grid and link it to the controller. Test it nearby first, then expand range after the basic connection works.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Targets cached Refined Storage 1.12.4 for Minecraft 1.20.1. Current 2.x documentation uses renamed machines; this guide keeps the verified 1.x IDs.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
